# US Estimates Pro — Full System Documentation

> Complete catalog of estimating services, CSI trade divisions, regional cost models, and contractor bidding resources.

## Overview
US Estimates Pro provides professional construction cost estimating, material quantity takeoffs, and bid preparation services. We serve General Contractors, Subcontractors, Architects, Developers, and Lenders across all 50 US states. All takeoffs are prepared by certified senior estimators utilizing industry-standard software (Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift) and calibrated with monthly regional RSMeans cost data.

## Turnaround & Accuracy Guarantee
- Turnaround: 24 to 48 hours for standard takeoffs, same-day for rush emergency bidding.
- Accuracy: 98.7% post-bid variance reconciliation verified across 1,840+ completed contractor bids.
- Deliverables: Unlocked Microsoft Excel workbooks (.XLSX) with live formulas, high-resolution color-coded marked up PDF drawings, and division summary sheets.
